issues.title: Op-Boxes in categories
issues.body:
We've realised there are about 60 standard areas - so we need to organise them a little better. So, they are being grouped into categories - with color shading.  I've changed our mock data to fit the new `AreaCategory` data structure.

* [x] introduce `category` of area includes name, color, list of areas
* [ ] render select menu using tiered data

Over to you now please @lebaphi 

The `StandardAreaMenu` now shows a single list of area items, each with the category name.  But, we really want a tiered menu.  I was able to implement the tiered menu, but the menu-click was failing.  I think you used a trick [here](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/2336/files#diff-e7637e7308bb915e168456de488b9acb633b7585f9ba0420a6426bd6bd667603R284) to prevent that.
